about: Tender awards published by National Treasury's eTenders portal (OCDS). Year = calendar year of the contract signature date, or of the release date when no signature date is published.

known_value sums only awards with a plausible value; missing_value counts no value or a R0 placeholder; implausible_value counts values below R100 or above R20bn (KE-007). Values are as published and can be multi-year, framework or estimated contract values, so totals are not annual spending.
top_supplier_share and hhi (Herfindahl index, 0-10,000) describe how concentrated the known award value is across suppliers; suppliers are not named here.
Award records (awards-YYYY.json) are public records as published; they are not flags or findings.
